top_news.summary: Kerala is set to host a major business and investment gathering as the Brand Keralam Conclave 2026, the fourth edition of the Profit Tusker Summit, takes place on October 15, 2026, at O by Tamara, Thiruvananthapuram. Organized by FYBB and The Profit News, the conclave will bring together business leaders, entrepreneurs, investors, industry experts and key stakeholders to explore strategies for positioning Kerala as a globally competitive destination for business, investment, manufacturing and international trade. "The Brand Keralam Conclave 2026 will be inaugurated by Kerala Chief Minister Shri V. D. Satheesan. The prestigious event will also witness the participation of several ministers from the Government of Kerala, alongside prominent business leaders, global investors, entrepreneurs and industry experts. Their participation will add significance to discussions on Kerala's investment opportunities, industrial development, international trade and long-term economic growth." Built around the vision of (Onnamathakanam Keralam) - an aspiration for Kerala to become a leader in economic development and enterprise - the conclave seeks to move beyond conventional business discussions and encourage meaningful dialogue on opportunities that can accelerate the state's economic transformation. With the theme "Rooted in Keralam. Ready for the World," the event aims to highlight Kerala's potential to emerge as a significant hub for global investment, entrepreneurship, innovation, exports and maritime commerce. From Business Recognition to Economic Transformation The Profit Tusker platform has steadily evolved into a forum connecting businesses, entrepreneurs and industry leaders from across India. Following three editions held in Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram and Kochi, the fourth edition introduces a focused conversation on Kerala's economic future under the Brand Keralam Conclave identity. Unlike traditional business conferences, Brand Keralam Conclave 2026 aims to encourage actionable discussions on investment, infrastructure development, entrepreneurship and industry collaboration. The event will focus on how Kerala can leverage its strategic geographical location, skilled workforce, expanding infrastructure, entrepreneurial ecosystem and international connections to strengthen its position in India's economic growth story. articles.summary: Kerala is set to host a major business and investment gathering as the Brand Keralam Conclave 2026, the fourth edition of the Profit Tusker Summit, takes place on October 15, 2026, at O by Tamara, Thiruvananthapuram. Organized by FYBB and The Profit News, the conclave will bring together business leaders, entrepreneurs, investors, industry experts and key stakeholders to explore strategies for positioning Kerala as a globally competitive destination for business, investment, manufacturing and international trade. "The Brand Keralam Conclave 2026 will be inaugurated by Kerala Chief Minister Shri V. D. Satheesan. The prestigious event will also witness the participation of several ministers from the Government of Kerala, alongside prominent business leaders, global investors, entrepreneurs and industry experts. Their participation will add significance to discussions on Kerala's investment opportunities, industrial development, international trade and long-term economic growth." Built around the vision of (Onnamathakanam Keralam) - an aspiration for Kerala to become a leader in economic development and enterprise - the conclave seeks to move beyond conventional business discussions and encourage meaningful dialogue on opportunities that can accelerate the state's economic transformation. With the theme "Rooted in Keralam. Ready for the World," the event aims to highlight Kerala's potential to emerge as a significant hub for global investment, entrepreneurship, innovation, exports and maritime commerce. From Business Recognition to Economic Transformation The Profit Tusker platform has steadily evolved into a forum connecting businesses, entrepreneurs and industry leaders from across India. Following three editions held in Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram and Kochi, the fourth edition introduces a focused conversation on Kerala's economic future under the Brand Keralam Conclave identity. Unlike traditional business conferences, Brand Keralam Conclave 2026 aims to encourage actionable discussions on investment, infrastructure development, entrepreneurship and industry collaboration. The event will focus on how Kerala can leverage its strategic geographical location, skilled workforce, expanding infrastructure, entrepreneurial ecosystem and international connections to strengthen its position in India's economic growth story.
